local function getDateInfo()
	local d=os.date("*t")

	if not d then
		return "--:--:--","Fecha no disponible"
	end

	local timeText=string.format(
		"%02d:%02d:%02d",
		d.hour,
		d.min,
		d.sec
	)

	local dateText=string.format(
		"%s, %d de %s de %d",
		Days[d.wday] or "",
		d.day,
		Months[d.month] or "",
		d.year
	)

	return timeText,dateText
end

local LastAttacker=nil
local LastHealth=nil

local function findAttacker()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,18

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if r then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function findClosestPlayer()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,math.huge

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local h=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			if r and h and h.Health>0 then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function connectCharacter(char)
	local hum=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	LastHealth=hum.Health

	hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(h)
		if h<LastHealth then
			local attacker=findAttacker()

			if attacker then
				LastAttacker=attacker
			end
		end

		LastHealth=h
	end)
end

local function requestOneSlap()
	if not AutoSlap or QueueWaiting then
		return

	QueueWaiting=true

	pcall(function()
		SlapQueue:FireServer()

local function sendOneSlap()
	if not AutoSlap or not QueueWaiting then
		return
	end

	QueueWaiting=false

	local now=os.clock()

	if now-LastSlapTime<SlapCooldown then
		return
	end

	LastSlapTime=now

	pcall(function()
		SendSlap:FireServer(SlapPower)
	end)
end

local frames=0

	frames+=1

	local now=os.clock()

	if now-lastTime>=.5 then
		fps=math.floor(
			frames/(now-lastTime)
		)

		frames=0
		lastTime=now
	end

	statTimer+=dt

	if statTimer>=.15 then
		statTimer=0

		local ping=math.floor(
			Player:GetNetworkPing()*1000+.5
		)

		local ram=math.floor(
			StatsService:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()

			Info.Text=string.format(
				"FPS: %d | RAM: %d MB | Ping: %d ms\nX: %.1f  Y: %.1f  Z: %.1f",

				ping,
				p.X,
